title: Geese: The Band
description: Brooklyn's restless young rock band: the basics. A small starter set, so add your questions and it will grow.

cards.prompt: Which New York borough is Geese from?
cards.details: They started out as teenagers in Brooklyn, making music together before they'd finished school.

cards.details: They were still teenagers when labels came calling, which is very unusual for an indie band.
